value.name: Asha reaches partners' floor
value.description: Asha rides the elevator up and steps out onto the partners' floor carrying the page she came to deliver.
evidence: when the doors opened on the partners' floor she walked out steady
with the page she had driven across a river to get still riding at her hip

value.name: Asha pauses outside Whitfield's office
value.description: She stops at Whitfield's door, composes herself, and prepares to knock.
evidence: Asha stopped a pace short of Whitfield's door
shifted the case to her other hand
and let her shoulders drop on a slow exhale before she lifted her knuckles

value.name: Asha reads Rosa's urgent message
value.description: Her phone buzzes with a message from Rosa telling her the boy signed without her and to tell Whitfield everything.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip
there were Rosa's two lines: the boy signed because you weren't there, tell Whitfield everything

value.name: Asha delays before knocking
value.description: She hesitates with the message in hand, then puts the phone away and knocks on Whitfield's door.
evidence: She read it standing at the door with her hand half-raised and did not move for a beat longer than she meant to
Then she put the phone back in her coat pocket, screen down, and knocked

value.name: Whitfield admits Asha into office
value.description: Whitfield answers from inside, and Asha opens the door and enters his office.
evidence: Whitfield's voice came through the door at the same volume he used for everything
and Asha turned the handle and stepped onto the carpet inside

value.name: Whitfield gestures Asha to sit
value.description: Whitfield remains at his desk and gestures for Asha to take a chair while he keeps reading.
evidence: He was at his desk with his reading glasses already on, a coffee untouched at his elbow, and he gestured her to the chair without looking up from the page in front of him

value.name: Asha refuses to sit
value.description: Asha ignores Whitfield's invitation to sit and moves directly to the desk.

value.name: Asha presents corrected page
value.description: Asha slides the corrected page toward Whitfield, beginning the handoff of the document she brought.
